title: Otter with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="42" ry="10" fill="#2E86C1"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="38" ry="7" fill="#5DADE2"/>
  <path d="M10 82 Q20 76 30 82 Q40 88 50 82 Q60 76 70 82 Q80 88 90 82" stroke="#AED6F1" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="15" ry="14" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="22" ry="19" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="26" r="7" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="26" r="4" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="26" r="7" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="26" r="4" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- face light patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="36" r="5.5" fill="#1B2631"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="36" r="5.5" fill="#1B2631"/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="34" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="34" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- tiny star sparkles -->
  <path d="M39 32 L39.5 33.5 L41 34 L39.5 34.5 L39 36 L38.5 34.5 L37 34 L38.5 33.5Z" fill="#F9E79F"/>
  <path d="M55 32 L55.5 33.5 L57 34 L55.5 34.5 L55 36 L54.5 34.5 L53 34 L54.5 33.5Z" fill="#F9E79F"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#3E2723"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="43" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#795548"/>
  <!-- muzzle lines -->
  <path d="M50 46 Q48 50 44 49" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M50 46 Q52 50 56 49" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="32" y1="44" x2="16" y2="40" stroke="#E8C39E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="47" x2="15" y2="47" stroke="#E8C39E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="50" x2="16" y2="54" stroke="#E8C39E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="44" x2="84" y2="40" stroke="#E8C39E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="47" x2="85" y2="47" stroke="#E8C39E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="50" x2="84" y2="54" stroke="#E8C39E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="70" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="70" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- paw toes -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="74" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="74" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 52 Q50 57 56 52" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
